units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 65b:12">B. Kam. 65ᵇ</cite> if one stole <he>טלה ונעשה א׳</he> a lamb and it grew to be a ram.
Ib. א׳ בן יומו קרוי א׳ a ram one day old is called a ram (ayil is used in a general sense, irrespective of age).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:16">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[*Pl. <cite ref="A01860"><he>אֵלִים</he></cite>. Tosef.

senses.gloss: א׳ קמצא [perh. אַיָּל q. v.] a species of locusts.
